# Global News

> > Canada's leading news source delivering breaking Canadian and international news across politics, business, health, sports and entertainment with live coverage and video content.

Global News is a comprehensive Canadian news organization providing real-time coverage of national and international events. The site aggregates breaking news, live streams, and multimedia content across multiple news categories including politics, finance, health, sports, and entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Canadian Politics
- World News
- Sports (NHL, MLB, NBA, CFL)
- Financial Markets & Economics
- Health & Wellness
- Entertainment & Celebrity
- Live News Coverage
- Canada-U.S. Relations
- Diplomacy & International Affairs
- Weather & Traffic
- Indigenous News
- Military & Defense
- Opinion & Commentary
- Lifestyle & Consumer News

## News Hubs & Breaking Coverage

- [Global News Homepage](https://globalnews.ca): Breaking Canadian news, politics, business, health and world coverage
- [Live: Canadian News Stream](https://globalnews.ca/live/national): Live Canadian news stream with weather, traffic, sports and breaking updates
- [Canada News](https://globalnews.ca/canada): Canadian national news with breaking headlines and provincial coverage
- [World News](https://globalnews.ca/world): Global News world section with international headlines and breaking news
- [News Videos](https://globalnews.ca/videos): News video library with latest coverage, weather, sports and breaking news

## Major News Categories

- [Politics](https://globalnews.ca/politics): Canadian politics coverage including federal, municipal and policy news
- [Money & Business](https://globalnews.ca/money): Financial news, stock market updates and Canadian economic coverage
- [Sports](https://globalnews.ca/sports): Sports news with NHL, MLB, NBA, CFL scores, stats and results
- [Health](https://globalnews.ca/health): Health, wellness and medical news with lifestyle coverage
- [Entertainment](https://globalnews.ca/entertainment): Entertainment and celebrity news with Hollywood gossip and TV coverage
- [Lifestyle](https://globalnews.ca/lifestyle): Lifestyle news covering entertainment, health, wellness and trending stories

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Commentary](https://globalnews.ca/commentary): Opinion and analysis commentary on Canadian news and community issues
- [Perspectives](https://globalnews.ca/perspectives): Perspectives section with features on indigenous news, sports and culture

## Special Features & Services

- [The Curator: Be in the know before you buy](https://globalnews.ca/the-curator): Product reviews, shopping guides and curated lifestyle recommendations
